Raw, chunked-zstd, sparse and prefix ties are strict and deterministic. Sparse None cannot beat Raw and is now documented as an omitted entry; unexpected encoder failures propagate.
Preparation finishes before exchange; winning encoded bodies are reused. Input, frame and request-batch bounds are checked before contacting the receiver.
